source: Ronda 22 (r18 t4-c19 «ponme el navegador y el word uno al lado del otro»: a failed mission's final listed «Verification page | Example Platform - Opera», «(14) Un día cualquiera…» and «Imagen sobre imagen», windows the request never named). The titles of a window read that a failed mission made, or that an effect after it needed, travel to the narrator only when the request asks what the windows are or show: a window noun, or a noun of what a window shows (revisión 2: «¿qué documento tengo abierto en Word?», «what page is open in chrome?», «¿qué programas tengo abiertos?», «¿qué tengo abierto en el navegador?»), after a list verb, a title noun or a which-word, within a short phrase. A which-word asks only when the request is a question (a question mark) or opens with it after the leads («y», «oye»): «minimiza lo que tengo abierto» asks nothing.
